sn44.5:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahā-Koṭṭhiko Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti Isipatane Migadāye || pe || 2-7
sn44.5:1.3: Ko nu kho āvuso hetu ko paccayo yena tam avyākatam Bhagavatā ti || || 8
sn44.5:1.4: Rūpe kho āvuso avigatarāgassa avigatachandassa avigatapemassa avigatapipāsassa avigatapariḷāhassa avigatataṇhassa Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti || pe ||
sn44.5:1.5: Neva hoti na na hoti param maraṇā ti pissa hoti || || 9-11
sn44.5:1.9: Viññāṇe avigatarāgassa avigatachandassa avigatapemassa avigatapipāsassa avigatapariḷāhassa avigatataṇhassa Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti || pe ||
sn44.5:1.10: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti || || 13
sn44.5:1.11: Rūpe ca kho āvuso vigatarāgassa || pa || 14-16
sn44.5:1.15: Viññāṇe vigatarāgassa vigatachandassa vigatapemassa vigatapipāsassa vigatapariḷāhassa vigatataṇhassa Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa na hoti || pe ||
sn44.5:1.16: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa na hoti || || 18
sn44.5:1.17: Ayaṃ kho āvuso hetu ayam paccayo yena tam avyākatam Bhagavatā
